svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: TMC9660: Typical application
svg.desc: Schematic of the TMC9660 typical application: the chip with U2 MCU, C1 capacitor ≥ 0.5 µF, C11 capacitor 10 µF, C2 capacitor ≥ 1 µF, C3 capacitor 1 µF, C4 capacitor 10 µF, C5 capacitor 10 µF, C6 capacitor 8 µF, C7 capacitor 4.7 µF, C8 capacitor 220 nF, C9 capacitor 1.6 µF, C10 capacitor 1.6 µF, L1 inductor 27 µH, R1 resistor 10 kΩ; the MCU wires carry the port hooks GpioGet(CtrlPin::Faultn), GpioSet(CtrlPin::DrvEn), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Reset), GpioSet(CtrlPin::Wake), Transfer().
svg.text: The TMC9660 on an MCU's SPI bus with the bootloader's default pins, RSTN and DRV_EN on GPIOs the driver drives through GpioSet() and FAULTN on an input read through GpioGet(). WAKE
is shorted to VSA. VSA is decoupled to the buck power ground GNDP (at least 0.5 uF next to the pin and a 10 uF bulk capacitor), and GNDP joins GND at one point under the chip. The motor
power stage (gate, bridge-centre, bootstrap and current-sense pins) is wired as in the datasheet and is not drawn. Above each MCU wire: the port hook that drives it. Datasheet: Pin
* Not confirmed in the datasheet: R1 10 kΩ: the pull-up value is a choice; the datasheet says FAULTN is open drain.
